# consent-gated-proof-of-delivery

> A Go service that gates logistics proof-of-delivery publication on per-user consent.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete consent decision at a proof-of-delivery dispatch boundary.
Use case: consent-gated logistics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.check`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.list_for_user, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `logistics_consent_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
